# S60 — Editor dialogs keep Save and Cancel above the keyboard

**Findings:** S48 walkthrough 2026-10-04: TrackerEditorDialog.kt:83-90 (AlertDialog with LazyColumn heightIn(max = 520.dp)); Save row partly under the IME on API 36, same at targetSdk 34 · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ui

**Not in this slice:** field validation (S14), the date and time pickers themselves (S40), and accessibility labels (S45).

## Why

On a Pixel 6 emulator (API 36), focusing the Name field in the New tracker dialog opens the keyboard over the bottom of the dialog: the Save button is cut off and only its top half shows above the keyboard. The same happens with a targetSdk 34 build, so it predates S48. Users fill in the name first, so Save is hidden at exactly the moment they reach for it.

## Files

- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/TrackerEditorDialog.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/EntryEditorDialog.kt` (check it for the same problem)

## Failing tests

- None automated. The emulator check below is the acceptance test.

## Implement

1. Reproduce first: Pixel 6 emulator, open New tracker, tap Name, take a screenshot. Save must be partly hidden.
2. Make the dialog fit the space above the keyboard: the confirm and dismiss row stays fully visible and the form scrolls inside the remaining height. The fixed `heightIn(max = 520.dp)` on the LazyColumn is the likely cause. Confirm the fix on the emulator; do not settle for a version that only works in a Preview.
3. Apply the same fix to `EntryEditorDialog` if step 1 also reproduces there.

## Check

- With the keyboard open on any field of either dialog, Save and Cancel are fully visible and tappable, on a Pixel 6 emulator in portrait and landscape and at font scale 1.3. Record the result with `slicer note`.
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
